full_page.content:
1932, December
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NC. 5.
Page 78 Cont.
Jos. Wigley - 51 - cancer of bladder - n. Cath.
Dec. Mrs.M. Reider - 43 - 7 year To-day baptized has tumor - fears oper- ation - husband unbeliever he seems to have stomach - cancer enroll- ed in S.M.A. To-day
Mrs. Ford J. Anthe - 50 - swelling on breast
Mrs. Hughes - 60 - Stroke, side, speech, mind.
Judy Mayers - 12 - fainting spells ... Grosse IL. Alois F. Herman Architect ... wants a P.O. Contract - hard-prest Wm. Carpenter - trying new business
Rose Carpenter
Joseph Cannon again James Worrell - painter etc. work
Mrs. Emma Dobbins - 63 - cancer
George Kelly of Chicago - losing sight
Frank J. Riopel - Fireman. .
Anthony Koviak - improving - eczema - wishes to thank for prayers. Engelbert Garland Blank Page
Page 79 Page 80 Dec. 21 Joseph McDon. - 26 - ... T.B.
Julius Matcheckosky - 6 - spastic paralysis Mrs. Pauline Grabowski - 59 - dying of cancer Minnie Parent - 61 - sore tongue - 4 months Trombleys - 3 with flu & wife sick Mrs. Gold ....
